title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
ii.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
iii.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
iv.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
v.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
colophon: a symmetry that almost holds, and the light that finds where it doesn't.
